text: You can create and log your first trace in under five minutes.
quote: Create and run your first trace in less than 5 minutes.

text: Experiments evaluate prompts, models, and application code against defined inputs and chosen metrics.
quote: Experiments allow you to evaluate prompts, models, and your application code, using well-defined inputs, against metrics of your choice.

text: The console UI has Create Experiment buttons for adding experiments to a project.
quote: In the Galileo console UI, "Create Experiment" buttons allow you to easily add experiments to a project.

text: You can start a first experiment using a sample dataset and a sample prompt.
quote: You can use a sample dataset and sample prompt to create your first experiment.

text: An official MCP server connects AI IDEs such as Cursor and VS Code with Copilot to Galileo's evaluation and observability platform.
quote: The Galileo Model Context Protocol (MCP) server enables seamless integration between AI-powered IDEs, such as Cursor, or VS Code with GitHub Copilot, and Galileo's evaluation and observability platform.

text: Through MCP you can create and manage datasets, run experiments, and set up prompt templates from your dev environment.
quote: With MCP, you can access Galileo's capabilities directly from your development environment, including: Creating and managing datasets, Running experiments, Setting up prompt templates

text: Agentic metrics measure how well agents perform multi-step tasks involving tools, decisions, and external systems.
quote: Agentic metrics help you measure how well your AI agents perform complex, multi-step tasks—especially when those agents need to use tools, make decisions, or interact with external systems.

text: Once instrumented, every session, trace, and span is captured as a structured real-time data stream.
quote: Once instrumented, Galileo captures every session, trace, and span, producing a structured stream of real-time data.

text: Spans sharing a trace ID are joined into one trace using OpenTelemetry's W3C traceparent header.
quote: OpenTelemetry's W3C `traceparent` header carries the trace context across the wire. Galileo joins all spans that share a trace ID into a single trace.

text: Traces from two agents running in different processes can be stitched together using OTel and the GalileoSpanProcessor.
quote: Stitch traces across two agents in different processes using OTel and the GalileoSpanProcessor.

text: LangGraph agents can be instrumented with OpenTelemetry and OpenInference to capture traces, spans, and metrics.
quote: Learn how to instrument a LangGraph agent with OpenTelemetry and OpenInference to capture detailed traces, spans, and metrics.

text: You can create custom LLM-as-a-judge metrics to evaluate domain-specific applications.
quote: Learn how to create custom LLM-as-a-Judge metrics to evaluate domain-specific applications within Galileo.

text: Custom metric types include decision model, LLM-as-a-judge, Luna, code-based, and composite code-based metrics.
quote: You can then expand these metrics with custom metrics: Decision model metrics, LLM-as-a-judge metrics, Luna metrics, Code-based metrics, Composite code-based metrics

text: Decision model metrics classify and score large volumes of text faster and more cheaply than LLM-as-a-judge.
quote: Create decision model metrics to classify and score large volumes of text faster and at a much lower cost than LLM-as-a-judge metrics.

text: Metrics can be global across all projects or scoped to selected projects.
quote: Choose whether a metric is global and available in every project, or project-scoped and available in selected projects.

text: Ready-to-use out-of-the-box metrics evaluate many aspects of AI system performance with no custom implementation.
quote: Galileo provides a comprehensive suite of out-of-the-box metrics designed to evaluate various aspects of AI system performance without requiring custom implementation.

text: Alerts are configured with a metric, an aggregation function, a threshold, and a time window, covering things like cost or correctness.
quote: Each alert configuration includes: a metric e.g. Cost, Correctness, Context Adherence; an aggregation function...; a threshold e.g. < 0.5; a time window e.g. 1 hour

text: You can get alerted when cost runs higher than expected or when the model hallucinates more than you want.
quote: Galileo enables you to get alerted whenever unexpected things happen. For example: Your cost is higher than expected, Your model is hallucinating more than you want

text: Metrics auto-tune from natural-language and live feedback to align better with your domain.
quote: This allows you to continuously provide feedback in natural language that automatically improves the metrics to align better with your domain, or expected inputs and outputs.

text: Optimized evals can be distilled into Luna models that monitor 100% of traffic at 96% lower cost.
quote: Distill your optimized evals into Luna models that monitor 100% of your traffic at 96% lower cost.

text: Datasets can be built from synthetic, development, and live production data, enriched with SME annotations.
quote: Build your datasets from synthetic, development, and live production data. Capture subject matter expert annotations to create a living asset that continuously grounds your AI systems.

text: Sessions, traces, and spans can be organized into queues for structured review by subject matter experts.
quote: Organize sessions, traces, and spans into queues for structured review by subject matter experts, making it easier to scale human feedback across your AI applications.

text: The SDK provides a @log decorator for logging spans.
quote: You can also use the `@log` decorator to log spans.

text: Instrumentation works in Python or TypeScript with OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, or Gemini LLMs.
quote: This guide works with Python or TypeScript, using OpenAI, Azure OpenAI service, Anthropic, or Gemini LLMs.

text: Works with all major LLM providers and popular agentic frameworks.
quote: Galileo works with all major LLM providers and can be used with your favorite agentic framework

text: LangChain agent activity, including tool use, can be logged and monitored.
quote: A simple LangChain-powered AI Agent that uses OpenAI's language models and a custom tool, with all agent activities logged and monitored in Galileo.

text: You can add evaluations to multi-agent LangGraph apps and view session-level metrics.
quote: By the end of this tutorial, you'll be able to: Add Galileo evaluations to a multi-agent LangGraph app, View and understand session level metrics

text: Monitors agent reliability and tool usage patterns.
quote: Track all interactions and performance with Galileo, Monitor agent reliability and tool usage patterns

text: Evaluates whether an agent is choosing the best tools or actions for each situation.
quote: Ensure your agent is choosing the best tools or actions for each situation.

text: A built-in AI Assistant helps troubleshoot your agentic system.
quote: Troubleshoot your agentic system with the AI Assistant.

text: An instruction_adherence metric monitors how closely the model follows the prompt.
quote: We'll enable the `instruction_adherence` metric to monitor the model's adherence to the prompt.

text: Helps identify and address hallucinations and factual errors in AI models.
quote: Learn how to identify and address hallucinations and factual errors in your AI models

text: Detects out-of-context RAG output, where the model generates information not found in the retrieved documents.
quote: This is the out-of-context problem in RAG systems - when a language model generates information not found in the retrieved documents.

text: A completeness metric checks whether RAG systems give complete answers.
quote: Learn how to ensure that your RAG systems provide complete answers using the Galileo completeness metric

text: Provides observability for RAG implementations, including document Q&A chatbots.
quote: This guide demonstrates a basic RAG implementation using Galileo's observability features.

text: Guide for setting up a Stripe AI agent with Galileo observability.
quote: Set up a complete Stripe AI agent with Galileo observability

text: The free plan includes 5,000 traces per month, unlimited users, and unlimited custom evals.
quote: Our Free plan includes: 5,000 traces per month, Unlimited users, Unlimited custom evals
